name: Deep Devourer's Domain
description:
Cards you Discard from your Hand or use for Tune will be devoured.
For every 3 cards devoured: All-Devouring Narwhal gains 1 extra Max HP when the Round ends. If there are any cards among these that have the same Current Elemental Dice Cost, gain another 1 extra Max HP. If all 3 cards have the same Current Elemental Dice Cost, gain yet another 1 extra Max HP.
